race.description: Goldfields Tattersalls Social Club C2 Hcp
race.comment: SAINTY CULLITY (1) won two back in a photo before missing in a photo last time out at 1400m when flying from the back of the pack. Back out to the mile now is a bonus and he can sit closer from a better draw this time. Nottle remains on board and he can raise the bar now. JUST SUBLIME (3) gets the blinkers on for the first time today and Fiore sticks with her today. She's drawn wide again today after missing as favourite her past couple and now out to the mile looks a bonus. Can be in the finish once again. MISS DEFIES ME (5) has been in the market at her last couple of runs but failed to threaten, the latest effort a modest seventh at Pinjarra Scarpside over 1400m. Rates highly on best figures - can do much better. PINKERTON (7) was sent out at $91 last time but ran above expectations and won over 1400m at this track. Can repeat the dose. MOONSHINE QUEEN (6) is third-up now and can improve.
